title: JDBC Unity Catalog connections will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
In mid-November 2026, JDBC Unity Catalog connections, including support for SSL certificates, will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Use JDBC Unity Catalog connections to connect to external databases with a custom JDBC driver, with access governed by Unity Catalog.

See [JDBC connection](/aws/en/connect/jdbc-connection).
